count_qualification: S1 used counts sum to 220, but its normalization-anchor footnote conflicts with some unchanged original/used counts. Recovered counts identify upstream channels, not 161 confirmed author-fit residuals. Isaak expansion specimen identity is unresolved.

milani_vt.protocol: Fixed source EOS; one constant molar-volume scale profiled with diagonal reported volume errors only. Temperature errors and shared calibration/anchor covariance are omitted. This is a conditional shape check, not the original normalization or a formal goodness-of-fit test.

milani_compression.protocol: Seven loaded rows; measured ambient row retained as normalization anchor. V=125.35*Vobs/Vambient. Equivalent quartz volumes inferred from the rounded original pressures using the author 1997 quartz EOS, then pressures calculated with Scheidl 2016 BM4. Original paired quartz readings are missing. T=298 K adopted; shared anchor covariance not used for a significance test.
milani_compression.source_s1_discrepancy: S1 says Milani 2015, 0-8.4 GPa; Milani 2017 deposit Table 3 has eight rows ending at 7.674 GPa, consistent with the 2017 citation in the article/EOS file. No pyrope table substituted.

kono.qualification: Fixed published coefficients and source modulus scale. Ambient T absent from Bass/Conrad tables is adopted as 298 K. No missing modulus error or covariance is synthesized. Conrad KS is derived from measured C11/C12, not an independent bulk-modulus measurement.

isaak_expansion_identity.reference_temperature_assumption: 293 K adopted for this illustrative ratio comparison from the stated start of the dilatometer runs. The tabulated strain reference is described as ambient, not independently established here as exactly 293 K.
isaak_expansion_identity.finding: Primary Table 2 observed strain is GR-2B (76.1% grossular, 22.1% andradite), not the 96.53% grossular GGD specimen listed for this expansion set in S1. Endmember alpha in Table 2 is a calculated compositional estimate, not measured endmember volumes. The original author input is needed to identify which column/reduction entered the 15 expansion channels.
